subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Is the internal skipped-path Mantis manifest enough proof for this generated-media wake-false fallback, or should the PR wait for a stacked live Telegram/gateway artifact?
rationale: The code shape is reviewable from source, but repository policy requires real behavior proof for external PRs and the available artifact says the normal Telegram interaction did not expose the path.

options.title: Require Stacked Live Proof
options.body: Keep this PR paused until the proof stack or an equivalent hook shows baseline missing/blocking the generated image and the candidate delivering exactly one visible result.

options.title: Accept Internal Manifest
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the Mantis fixed=true manifest and scheduler tests as sufficient for this internal failure mode while owning the remaining live-visibility uncertainty.

options.title: Close Or Re-scope Proof
options.body: If maintainers decide this path cannot be usefully proven through Mantis, move proof expectations to targeted gateway logs or a smaller harness before merging.

recommendation.title: Require Stacked Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR paused until the proof stack or an equivalent hook shows baseline missing/blocking the generated image and the candidate delivering exactly one visible result.
